- Play on the floor with my grandkids (People I love) [depends on: mobility, flexibility, strength]

- Stay in my own home, on my terms (My freedom) [depends on: strength, balance, mind]
- Keep playing the sport I love (Things I love) [depends on: mobility, strength, balance]
- Hike the hills with friends (Things I love) [depends on: stamina, balance, connection]
Abilities these choices depend on most: strength (4), balance (4), mobility (2), flexibility (1), stamina (1), mind (1), connection (1)
People they named: Jenny
In LIFT, where one of their weakest scores limits an ability these choices depend on, say so in one clause and name the choice. In THRIVE, use their choices and the people they named. Do not invent choices or people that are not listed here.
What their choices depend on, with what was measured (out of 5, higher is better; Stage 1 answers run 1 to 5, Stage 3 answers 0 to 5):
- Strength: 4 of their choices; measured 2.5/5 from Chair stand (30 seconds) 3/5, Getting up from the floor (Stage 1) 2/5
- Mobility: 2 of their choices; measured 2/5 from Getting up from the floor (Stage 1) 2/5
- Flexibility: 1 of their choices; nearest measure 2/5 from Getting up from the floor (Stage 1) 2/5
- Balance: 4 of their choices; measured 1/5 from Standing on one leg 1/5
- Stamina: 1 of their choices; measured 4/5 from Physical activity 4/5, Climbing stairs (Stage 1) 4/5
- A sharp mind: 1 of their choices; measured 2.3/5 from Mental activity 2/5, Stress 3/5, Sleep quality 2/5
- Connection: 1 of their choices; measured 5/5 from Time with people 5/5
Focus areas (most chosen, weakest measured): Balance, Strength, Mobility
HOW TO USE THESE CHOICES: this client has one assessment, so describe where they stand today against what each choice needs, not a trend. Do not invent choices or people that are not listed here.
